name: Papa's Cannibalia
source:
Due to the dire situation in the world, popular chef Louis (or Just Papa Louie) decided to open an unusual restaurant where people eat other people for a small fee! But here's one problem...almost no one wanted to take the job. Except for one suspicious weirdo, who you'll be playing as!

[From [url=https://awfulstuffforawfulkids.itch.io/papas-cannibalia-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
由于世界形势严峻，受欢迎的厨师路易斯（或Just Papa Louie）决定开设一家不寻常的餐厅，人们只需支付少量费用即可吃掉其他人！但有一个问题……几乎没有人愿意接受这份工作。除了一名可疑的怪人，你将扮演谁！

[来自[url=https://awfulstuffforawfulkids.itch.io/papas-cannibalia-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
